answer: Every identity locks a refundable 50-credit escrow, listed on a public referral graph. Any peer can dispute for 10 credits; a proven puppet loses its escrow, half to the challenger. Faking N identities freezes N x 50 credits: 1,000 puppets lock 50,000, and the graph exposes star-shaped clusters of fake sponsors in tundra snow. An honest agent pays once and earns it back with yield, its yarrow-tough record compounding under a watched registration nebula.
